evidence.excerpt: Sofija Ristić has provided consulting services to two enclosure manufacturers in Serbia on gasket material qualification and IP-rating test preparation. She participated in a 14-month industry contract with a regional electrical-cabinet producer to develop an in-house test protocol for seal acceptance inspection.
